strings.raw:
Combat
Press \ / 5 to attack. Press multiple times in a row to perform a combo attack. Kratos can perform combo attacks while in the air.

Movement
Use the number or directional keys to navigate Kratos through the environment. Press [ / 4 or ] / 6 to run, press { / 2 to jump, press } / 8 to block attacks.

Weapons and Magic
Cycle through weapons and magic by pressing * or the Left Soft Key. The icon of the currently equipped weapon or magic is found inside the Blade Icon.

Health Meter
The green bar found inside the Blade Icon is the Health Meter. It is refilled by collecting Green Health Orbs from fallen enemies and glowing Green Chests.

Magic Meter
The blue bar found inside the Blade Icon is the Magic Meter. Collecting Blue Magic Orbs from fallen enemies and glowing Blue Chests refill it.

Red Orb Counter
A Red Orb counter is directly below the Blade Icon. Red Orbs are used to power up weapons and magic. Collecting Red Magic Orbs from fallen enemies and glowing Red Chests increase the counter. When a new level is unlocked, the maximum number of Red Orbs that can be collected for the entire game increases. Once Kratos has collected the maximum number of Orbs available, Orbs will no longer appear in-game when opening Chests or defeating enemies.

Power Up Menu
Press # for the Power Up menu. Press { / 2 or } / 8 to select the weapon or magic you desire to strengthen, then press and hold \ / 5 to spend any Red Orbs you've acquired.

Phoenix Feathers
Phoenix Feathers are hidden in unmarked Chests. Find a Phoenix Feather to permanently increase the size of the Magic Meter.

Gorgon Eyes
Gorgon Eyes are hidden in unmarked Chests. Find a Gorgon Eye to permanently increase the size of the Health Meter.

Arena Mode
In the Arena, Kratos must defeat as many enemies as possible without dying. As you defeat enough enemies, the doors blocking the upper levels of the Arena will open. Only the total number of defeated enemies will appear at the bottom of the screen during this mode.
